'''Rebel dark trooper hunters''' were specialized [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] trained to hunt down [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rebel_dark_trooper_hunter.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Another type of Rebel dark trooper hunter.]]
Rebel dark trooper hunters are [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. They appear in [[:w:c:swg:Faction Base|Special Forces Field Hospitals]] that can be placed by Rebel-aligned players and can only be entered by [[Wikipedia:Player versus player|PVP]]-enabled ("Special Forces") players.
